sloka: ततस्त्रिजटया सार्धं पुष्पकादवरुह्य सा ।अशोकवनिकामेव राक्षसीभिः प्रवेशिता ।। ६.४८.३६ ।।।।
transliteration: tatastrijaṭayā sārdhaṁ puṣpakādavaruhya sā ।aśokavanikāmeva rākṣasībhiḥ praveśitā ।। 6.48.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter Sita along with Trijata went to Pushpaka. Making Sita to get down, rakshasi also entered Ashoka grove.
